# ASTITVA 2K26 — Official Festival Information
> Annual Sports, Cultural, Gaming & Literary Festival of LNJPIT Chapra

- **Festival Dates**: 4 September 2026 – 8 September 2026
- **Location**: Lok Nayak Jai Prakash Institute of Technology (LNJPIT), NH-19, Chapra, Bihar 841302, India
- **Official Website**: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app
- **Affiliation**: Aryabhatta Knowledge University (AKU) / Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of Bihar

## Festival Categories
1. **Sports**: Cricket, Fun Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Badminton (Singles & Doubles), Table Tennis, Chess
2. **Cultural**: Solo Dance, Group Dance, Singing, Standup Comedy, Ramp Walk, Night Cultural Party
3. **Gaming**: BGMI Squad Battle, Free Fire Championship
4. **Literary**: Parliamentary Debate, Mega Fest Quiz, Poetry Slam, Creative Writing

## Core Features
- Live real-time match scoring and tournament bracket feeds
- Encrypted QR code gate scanner and attendance badge system
- Verifiable PDF certificates with cryptographic digital signatures at /verify-certificate/[id]
- AI Festival Assistant (Astitva Bot) for natural language schedule queries

## Key Routes
- Tournaments & Events: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/events
- Live Schedule: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/schedule
- Live Leaderboard: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/leaderboard
- Match Results: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/results
- Announcements: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/announcements
- FAQs: https://astitva-2k26.vercel.app/faq
